source: Virginia Department of Elections campaign finance report files (apps.elections.virginia.gov/SBE_CSV/CF/ ScheduleA.csv cash contributions and ScheduleB.csv in-kind contributions). Totals use the latest filing per ReportUID in the months that include schedule files on this machine: 2022-01 through 2023-01 and 2026-01 through 2026-10. Months 2023-02 through 2025-12 have report headers only (no Schedule A/B in the local archive, and the live state CSV host blocked a refresh). Committee page IDs are official AccountId values on cfreports.elections.virginia.gov. No Virginia Public Access Project data.
